<div class="page-title-wrapper">
<h1 class="page-title">Health and well-being</h1>
<p class="page-lede">
<a href="https://stories.nd.edu/topics/health/health-and-well-being/" class="btn btn--lede" aria-label="Read about how Notre Dame's research and scholarship is leading to a healthier society">From preventing certain UTIs to developing mental health interventions, Notre Dame research and scholarship is leading to a healthier society.
</a>
</p>

<div class="page-secondary full-width">
<section class="section section--home-wwyff col--md">
<hr class="vertical">
<div class="section-intro col--sm text-center">
<h2 class="section-title section-title--lg">Where challenge meets <em>hope</em>.</h2>
<p class="lede">Notre Dame scholars and researchers pursue breakthroughs for a world in need.</p>
<p>United by our commitment to the common good, the global Notre Dame community builds bridges between the world we know and the world we desire. <em>What would you fight for?</em> For us, it is not just a question. It's a call to action.</p> </div>
<ul class="no-bullets flex-auto mb-0">
<li class="card-container">
<div class="card animate animate--fade-in">
<figure class="card-image"><img src="/assets/images/home/ff-second-chances-400.webp" width="400" height="533" alt="Three people walk and talk through a lush, grassy field with wildflowers next to rows of solar panel arrays on a bright sunny day." loading="lazy"></figure>
<div class="card-body">
<h3 class="card-title"><a class="card-link" href="https://stories.nd.edu/stories/fighting-for-second-chances/">Providing second chances</a></h3>
<p class="card-summary">Through Notre Dame’s Inspired Leadership Initiative, Marty Whalen turned a second act into second chances for formerly incarcerated people.</p>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li class="card-container">
<div class="card animate animate--fade-in">
<figure class="card-image"><img src="/assets/images/home/ff-online-bullying-400.webp" width="400" height="533" alt="Woman with long brown hair in a green Notre Dame sweatshirt with the ND monogram poses against a dark background, the left side of the portrait distorted by a vertical ribbed-glass effect." loading="lazy"></figure>
<div class="card-body">
<h3 class="card-title"><a class="card-link" href="https://stories.nd.edu/stories/fighting-online-abuse-using-ai">Using AI to prevent online abuse</a></h3>
<p class="card-summary">With athletes noting increases in cyberstalking and harassment, Notre Dame is leveraging the power of AI to identify and stop abuse.</p>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li class="card-container">
<div class="card animate animate--fade-in">
<figure class="card-image"><img src="/assets/images/home/ff-prevent-infections-400.webp" width="400" height="533" alt="A researcher wearing safety goggles, a lab coat, and blue nitrile gloves uses tweezers to lower tubing into a glass flask filled with clear liquid." loading="lazy"></figure>
<div class="card-body">
<h3 class="card-title"><a class="card-link" href="https://stories.nd.edu/stories/fighting-to-prevent-infections/">Prevent infections</a></h3>
<p class="card-summary">Notre Dame researchers have created a novel catheter adaptation that prevents infections before they begin.</p>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li class="card-container">
<div class="card animate animate--fade-in">
<figure class="card-image"><img src="/assets/images/home/ff-clean-water-400.webp" width="400" height="533" alt="A young child in a pink shirt and red skirt drinks clean water directly flowing from an outdoor hand-operated water pump." loading="lazy"></figure>
<div class="card-body">
<h3 class="card-title"><a class="card-link" href="https://stories.nd.edu/stories/fighting-for-universal-access-to-clean-water/">Access to clean water</a></h3>
<p class="card-summary">More than 700 million people lack access to clean water, but research from the University of Notre Dame is helping organizations optimize how they manage, maintain, and build water pumps to reduce water scarcity.</p>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li class="card-container">
<div class="card animate animate--fade-in">
<figure class="card-image"><img src="/assets/images/home/ff-vine-robots-400.webp" width="400" height="533" alt="Two people in red helmets examine equipment amidst rubble." loading="lazy"></figure>
<div class="card-body">
<h3 class="card-title"><a class="card-link" href="https://stories.nd.edu/stories/fighting-for-robotic-search-and-rescue/">Robotic search and rescue</a></h3>
<p class="card-summary">Notre Dame engineer develops vine robot to help first responders after disasters.</p>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li class="card-container">
<div class="card animate animate--fade-in">
<figure class="card-image"><img src="/assets/images/home/ff-nonverbal-400.webp" width="400" height="533" alt="A grandfather kisses the forehead of his granddaughter in a wheelchair wearing sunglasses as they share a quiet, affectionate moment outdoors." loading="lazy"></figure>
<div class="card-body">
<h3 class="card-title"><a class="card-link" href="https://stories.nd.edu/stories/fighting-for-nonverbal-communication/">Nonverbal communication</a></h3>
<p class="card-summary">Notre Dame researchers are developing AI technology designed to help caregivers interpret the nonverbal communication of people with profound intellectual and multiple disabilities.</p>
</div>
</div>
</li>
</ul>

<p>Discovery at Notre Dame is grounded in ethical inquiry and a commitment to human flourishing. Across disciplines, our faculty and students are leading where they are needed most, working with partners to bring research and scholarship to bear on urgent challenges at home and abroad.</p> </div>
